lineage_scoring: single pooled z-transform fitted once across all spots at depth T; never refitted per cohort; sc.tl.score_genes NOT used
region_definition: compositional (cardiomyocyte-argmax), NOT histologic; comparator sections carry NO lesion exclusion
estimator: section-level pseudobulk + limma-voom; unit of inference = section
q2_contrast: 17 diseased (11 CS + 6 comparators) vs 4 normal donors; hit must be up in BOTH disease sources independently
q1_contrast: 11 CS vs 6 comparator sections; comparators NEVER pooled with normal donors
